scenes.say: How many people do you need in a room for a better-than-even chance two share a birthday? It's way fewer than you think.
Most people guess around half of {days}. Not even close.
The trick: you think about someone matching you. But you have to count every pair. {n50} people make {pairs_n50} pairs.
When judging a coincidence, count all the ways it could happen, not just the ones about you.
